backend_framework.value: FastAPI 0.115 on Python 3.12 with async route handlers and Uvicorn ASGI server.

llm_architecture.value: Decoupled LLM abstraction using the Factory and Strategy patterns in backend/llm/factory.py.

supported_llm_providers.value: Local Nemotron (via llama-server port 8081), Groq (qwen3.8-27b), and Google AI Studio Gemini (gemini-3.8-flash).

file_access_security.value: ProjectFileManager enforces strict path traversal protection and automatically blocks sensitive files (.env) and binary files.

vector_embeddings.value: 256-dimensional SubwordSemanticEmbedder with L2 normalization and cosine similarity calculation.

rag_pipeline.value: In-memory ProjectRAGIndex with sliding window chunking (35 lines, 8 line overlap) injecting code chunks into prompts.

code_formatting.value: Use Black and Ruff with 88-character max line length.

target_project.value: Online Course Enrollment Portal — A web-based academic platform supporting student registration, searchable course listings, automated enrollment management, timetable conflict detection, and an administrative dashboard.

student_registration.value: Student registration module: Manages secure student onboarding, student ID generation, major/degree program selection, contact details, and completed prerequisite tracking.

course_listings.value: Course catalog & listings module: Displays course codes (e.g. CS101, MATH201, BIO105), titles, descriptions, assigned instructors, credit values (1-4 credits), capacity limits, and weekly meeting time slots (days and start/end times).

enrollment_management.value: Enrollment management module: Handles course add/drop operations, validates prerequisite completion, enforces maximum 18-credit per semester limits, and automatically invokes the conflict detection engine before confirming registration.

admin_dashboard.value: Admin dashboard module: Comprehensive administrative portal for department chairs and registrars to create/update courses, assign faculty instructors, monitor room capacities, review enrollment stats, and override waitlists.

conflict_detection_engine.value: AI Scheduling Conflict Detector: Analyzes student timetable slots for overlapping days and time intervals (e.g. Course A on Mon/Wed 10:00-11:30 vs Course B on Mon/Wed 10:30-12:00), detects exam date clashes, and flags instructor double-booking.

development_roadmap.value: Development Roadmap: Phase 1: Database Schema & Student Registration; Phase 2: Course Listings & Catalog Search; Phase 3: Enrollment Engine & Scheduling Conflict Detection; Phase 4: Admin Dashboard, Analytics & Deployment.

scheduling_rules.value: Core scheduling policies: 1) Overlap Constraint: Courses with overlapping time intervals on the same weekday are disallowed. 2) Credit Limit: Maximum 18 credits per semester. 3) Capacity Limit: Enrollment cannot exceed maximum room capacity.

decisions.title: Adopt Strategy & Factory Patterns for Multi-LLM Support
decisions.description: All LLM integrations implement BaseLLMProvider so chat endpoints remain provider-agnostic.
decisions.rationale: Allows switching between local offline models (Nemotron) and cloud APIs (Groq, Gemini) with zero code changes.

decisions.title: Adopt In-Memory Vector Index for Phase 12
decisions.description: Built custom ProjectRAGIndex with cosine similarity and sliding window chunking.
decisions.rationale: Keeps learning curve gentle and avoids heavy vector DB daemon dependencies for local dev.

decisions.title: Adopt In-Memory Vector Index for Phase 12
decisions.description: Built custom ProjectRAGIndex with cosine similarity and sliding window chunking.
decisions.rationale: Keeps learning curve gentle and avoids heavy vector DB daemon dependencies for local dev.

decisions.title: Adopt Interval Collision Algorithm for Timetable Conflict Detection
decisions.description: Implemented deterministic interval overlap detection comparing start and end minutes on matching weekdays to prevent scheduling conflicts during course enrollment.
decisions.rationale: Prevents double-booking students and guarantees instantaneous conflict feedback before database commit.

decisions.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Student vs Admin Portals
decisions.description: Partitioned the course portal into Student Views (catalog browsing, enrollment) and Admin Views (course authoring, capacity overrides, reports).
decisions.rationale: Ensures academic security and prevents unauthorized modification of course limits or grades.

decisions.title: Four-Phase Agile Development Roadmap for Course Portal
decisions.description: Adopted a 4-phase milestone roadmap covering Auth/Schema (Sprint 1), Catalog Search (Sprint 2), Conflict Detection Engine (Sprint 3), and Admin Dashboard (Sprint 4).
decisions.rationale: Enables modular verification of the conflict detector before assembling the complete web interface.
